- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The JCS is composed of the chairman and vice-chairman of the Joint Chiefs and the heads of the Army, Navy, Air Force, and Marine Corps.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The JCS provides strategic advice to the President on military readiness, force structure, and the use of military power.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The JCS plays a critical role in the development and implementation of national security policies and strategies.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations made by the JCS are typically confidential and not disclosed to the public.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The JCS works closely with the President and civilian leadership of the Department of Defense to align military decisions with broader national security objectives.
